node.name: postcss.config.mjs
node.rich_text:
## What is `postcss.config.mjs`?
**PostCSS** is a **CSS processor** — it takes your CSS and transforms it before the browser sees it. This config file tells PostCSS which plugins to use.
---
### Your config is very simple:
```js plugins: { "@tailwindcss/postcss": {} ← only one plugin } ```
It runs one plugin: **Tailwind CSS**.
---
### How the chain works:
``` You write CSS / Tailwind classes │ ▼ PostCSS reads it │ ▼ @tailwindcss/postcss plugin runs │ ▼ Generates final CSS the browser understands │ ▼ Browser renders your styles ```
---
### Simple analogy:
``` PostCSS = a factory machine Plugin = the tool inside the machine Config file = settings for the machine
Your CSS goes in → processed → clean CSS comes out ```
---
### Why Tailwind needs PostCSS:
Tailwind CSS works by **scanning your code** for class names like `flex`, `text-red-500`, `p-4` and generating only the CSS that's actually used. PostCSS is what triggers that scan and generation process.
---
### Key facts:
| Fact | Detail | |---|---| | **Auto-runs?** | Yes — every time `npm run dev` or `npm run build` runs | | **Edit it?** | Rarely — only if adding new CSS plugins | | **Without it?** | Tailwind classes would not work | | **File extension `.mjs`** | Modern JavaScript module format |
---
### Summary:
``` postcss.config.mjs = tells PostCSS to run Tailwind CSS on your styles before sending to browser
You never touch this file — it just silently makes Tailwind CSS work in your project. ```
